verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs confirm content can be imported/exported in Markdown format (and 'Any-Block') at any time, and Markdown files can be migrated in from tools like Obsidian, giving a documented open-format export path. However, JSON export for notes is not explicitly documented, and community feedback (comm-13) notes you can't just use raw Markdown/CSV files with Anytype, suggesting the native storage isn't plain open files even though export exists — a real caveat for archival independence. Missing for 10: explicit JSON export documentation, independent hands-on confirmation that exported Markdown preserves full fidelity, and resolution of the community concern about non-portable native storage.
